title: 54% Less Code Written: Ponytail Skill Stops AI Agents Overbuilding
description:
Fifty four percent less code written Measured on real Claude Code sessions Twelve feature tasks in a real repo

Ponytail is a skill for AI agents that stops the agent before it writes code. It forces two questions in order every time: does this need to exist at all, and if not, skip it entirely. Then it asks whether the logic already exists in the codebase, and if yes, reuse it instead of rewriting.

The project benchmark measured a mean 54 percent reduction in lines of code across twelve feature tasks in a real repository, using Haiku 4.5 with four runs per task. No config file is required to run it.

It works with multiple agent hosts including Claude Code, Codex, Copilot CLI, and others through a plugin marketplace.

Project benchmark: -54% LOC mean across 12 tasks (n=4, Haiku 4.5) | 107,834 stars | MIT license
